newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Motor driven up by pension funds.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Motor driven up by pension funds.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp's shares hit a record high in the Tuesday morning session on buying by institutional investors, particularly pension funds, brokers said.
At midday, the shares were 200 yen higher at 4,010. Turnover was 4.26 million shares.

"Under normal circumstances it would not be surprising if the shares were to undergo a correction. But buying interest is so strong, sellers are diminishing as the share price rises," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
"Institutional investors are absorbing cash stocks, which means fundamentals are improving and the share price could go higher yet," he added.
